title: AI Website Chatbot — Model Agnostic, Grounded, Lead Capture

sections.label: 1 · CHAT INTAKE
sections.note: The widget posts straight in. Session and any known visitor details load first, so a returning visitor is not asked to repeat themselves and the conversation has context from the first message.

sections.label: 2 · THE ASSISTANT
sections.note: One agent, with the model as a swappable sub-node. Claude, GPT or Gemini is a one-node change, which matters because you named three providers and picking one now is the wrong time to decide. Retrieval keeps answers on your own content instead of general knowledge.

sections.label: 3 · ANSWER OR HAND OFF
sections.note: A single check decides whether the bot replies on its own or pulls a human in. Anything it cannot support from your content, plus any explicit request for a person, goes to the handoff path rather than being guessed at.

sections.label: 4 · CAPTURE + RESPOND
sections.note: Every conversation is written down with the transcript attached, so the chatbot doubles as a lead source instead of a support cost. The reply streams back to the widget either way.

nodes.label: Can It Answer, or Does a Human Step In?

input_sample.message: Do you integrate with Shopify, and what does the starter plan actually include?

output_sample.reply: Yes, Shopify is a native integration. Starter covers 2 seats, 5,000 conversations a month and the Shopify + Stripe connectors. Want me to check if your store volume fits it?
